entries.zh: 剥皮；剥去（人或兽）的皮
entries.en: to flay, to skin; to strip off the skin
entries.notes: 西语「quitar la pellejo」处标[疑]（疑为 la piel 之笔误）；「剥皮」之义四栏互证清晰

entries.zh: 强行剥皮〔汉字第二字「未/末」待考〕
entries.en: to skin by force, to flay violently
entries.notes: 汉字疑「未/末」，与两栏对音对应之字未定；依西语 por fuerza 释作「强行剥皮」

entries.zh: 蝉退，蝉蜕壳；蝉蜕（蝉所蜕下之皮壳，旧亦入药）
entries.en: the cicada casts its skin; cicada slough
entries.notes: 闽南语栏多出第三音节 ʃê 未定，不影响词义

entries.zh: 扒皮；剥去果皮
entries.en: to peel (fruit), to strip the skin off fruit
entries.notes: 首字疑「扒/朳」；依西语 la fruta 与两栏对音定作「扒皮」

entries.zh: 跳；蹦跳乱动、行事颠乱无序
entries.en: to act erratically, in disorder; to jump about restlessly

entries.zh: 非法；行事不法、违越法度
entries.en: unlawful, illegal; to act against the law

entries.zh: 野；粗野、放纵不羁
entries.en: wild, unruly; uncouth
entries.notes: 「野」字声调记 T99（污损难辨）；词义四栏相合，仅声调存缺

entries.zh: 非正路；不走正道、行事不正当
entries.en: to act crookedly, off the right path; improper conduct
entries.notes: 「正」字声调记 T99；「非正路」字义明白，与 desordenado en hacer 相合

entries.zh: 非为；为非作歹、行为不正
entries.en: wrongdoing, misconduct

entries.zh: 世情；世俗习气〔与「行止失序」对应欠切，存疑〕
entries.en: worldly ways, worldly manners; glossed as disorderly in conduct
entries.notes: 首字声调 T99，音写 ʃy 与「世」字对音有出入，且「世情」与西语「行为失序」对应不明确

entries.zh: 紊乱；杂乱无章
entries.en: disorderly, in confusion; unsystematic
entries.notes: 西语「desamarañada」拼写标[疑]（或当作 desamañada「无章法」）；汉字「紊乱」与对音明确

entries.zh: 滥三（即今闽南语「滥糁」）：马虎随便、生活行事放任无度
entries.en: to live in a disorderly, haphazard way; careless, unrestrained
entries.notes: 「滥三」当为今闽南语「滥糁」（随意马虎之义）之记写

entries.zh: 发落；处置发落（如结办讼案）
entries.en: to dispose of, to settle (a lawsuit); to dispatch
entries.notes: 「ut pleyto」疑为「un pleyto」；义为对讼案、人犯之发落，汉字与对音清楚

entries.zh: 打发；差遣、打发（人）离去
entries.en: to dispatch, to send off (a person)

entries.zh: 文书；公文（呈递国王或官员之文书）
entries.en: official document(s); to dispatch paperwork to the King or a Mandarin
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 按 por 展开；「文书」谓公文、案牍

entries.zh: 批允；批示应允（准其所请）
entries.en: to approve, to grant (a petition)
entries.notes: 首字疑「批/挞」且「允」字声调 T99；依西语 petición 与两栏对音释作「批允」

entries.zh: 开拆；拆开（迅速打开信件、包裹、箱件）
entries.en: to open up, to unpack; to open (a letter or package) quickly

entries.zh: 拆断；扯断、折断
entries.en: to break off, to tear apart

entries.zh: 决断；断然处置、果断决定
entries.en: to decide, to settle (a matter) decisively; decisive

entries.zh: 起本；起草奏本（官员上呈皇帝之本章）
entries.en: to draft a memorial to the throne; to submit a dispatch to the King
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 按 por 展开；「起本」谓官员起草奏本上呈
